jk_temple.name: J.K. Temple (Radhakrishna Temple)
jk_temple.description: Exquisite white marble temple constructed in 1960 by the Singhania family, showcasing a blend of ancient Nagara and modern architectural spires.

allen_forest_zoo.name: Allen Forest Zoo (Kanpur Zoological Park)
allen_forest_zoo.description: Sprawling over 190 acres in a natural lush forest around a lake, recognized as one of Asia's few open-range zoological parks.

moti_jheel_park.name: Moti Jheel & Lake Promenade
moti_jheel_park.description: Historic drinking water reservoir dating to the British era transformed into Kanpur's favorite recreational haven with boating, musical fountains, and children's parks.
moti_jheel_park.best_time_to_visit: Evenings (Directly at Moti Jheel Metro Station)

bithoor_brahmavart_ghat.name: Brahmavart Ghat (Bithoor)
bithoor_brahmavart_ghat.description: The holiest ghat in Bithoor where Lord Brahma is believed to have created the universe after performing a grand Ashvamedha Yajna, venerating the sacred Brahma Khunti nail.
bithoor_brahmavart_ghat.best_time_to_visit: Kartik Poornima or sunrise on the Ganga

valmiki_ashram_bithoor.name: Maharishi Valmiki Ashram (Bithoor)
valmiki_ashram_bithoor.description: Elevated sanctuary where Sage Valmiki composed the immortal epic Ramayana, Goddess Sita resided during exile, and Luv and Kush were born and trained.

nana_rao_park.name: Nana Rao Park (Company Bagh)
nana_rao_park.description: Historic public park dedicated to 1857 freedom fighters Nana Saheb Peshwa and Tatya Tope, built on the site of the former Bibighar memorial.

phool_bagh.name: Phool Bagh & Ganesh Udyan
phool_bagh.description: Grand historic garden in civil lines housing the Kanpur City Museum (Sangrahalaya) and the historic KEM Hall where Mahatma Gandhi and national leaders addressed rallies.

kanpur_memorial_church.name: Kanpur Memorial Church (All Souls' Cathedral)
kanpur_memorial_church.description: Magnificent red-brick Lombardic Gothic cathedral consecrated in 1875 to honor fallen soldiers of the 1857 Siege of Cawnpore, featuring Baron Marochetti's Angel of Peace.

iskcon_temple_kanpur.name: ISKCON Temple Kanpur (Sri Sri Radha Madhav)
iskcon_temple_kanpur.description: Massive 15-acre Vedic cultural complex on Mainavati Marg with a towering marble temple, Goshala, organic gardens, and Govinda's pure vegetarian restaurant.

green_park_stadium.name: Green Park International Cricket Stadium
green_park_stadium.description: Historic 32,000-seater cricket arena beside the Ganga that hosted India's 500th Test Match, named after Madam Green who exercised here in the 1940s.

massacre_ghat.name: Massacre Ghat (Sati Chaura Ghat)
massacre_ghat.description: Historic river landing on the sacred Ganga renowned in colonial chronicles as the focal site of the 1857 boat ambush during the Indian Rebellion.
massacre_ghat.best_time_to_visit: Sunrise or sunset on the Ganga

jain_glass_temple.name: Jain Glass Temple (Kanch Ka Mandir)
jain_glass_temple.description: Dazzling temple in Maheshwari Mohalla adorned entirely with intricate glass mosaics, Belgian mirrors, and enamel murals illustrating Jain Jainology.
jain_glass_temple.best_time_to_visit: Daytime to appreciate the glass reflections

anandeshwar_temple_parmat.name: Shri Anandeshwar Temple (Parmat Mandir)
anandeshwar_temple_parmat.description: Hailed as the 'Kashi of Kanpur', this ancient Shiva temple on the banks of Ganga enshrines a self-manifested Shivalinga revered by millions of pilgrims.

panki_hanuman_mandir.name: Panki Hanuman Mandir
panki_hanuman_mandir.description: Centuries-old miraculous Hanuman shrine in Panki established by Mahant Sri Salik Ramji; focal point of Uttar Pradesh's historic Budhwa Mangal fairs.

kamla_retreat.name: Kamla Retreat (Singhania Heritage Estate)
kamla_retreat.description: Private estate of the Singhania industrial house featuring landscaped gardens, canals with artificial waves, swimming pools, and a private archaeological museum.
kamla_retreat.best_time_to_visit: October to March (Prior visitor permission required)

z_square_mall.name: Z Square Mega Mall (The Mall Road)
z_square_mall.description: One of North India's premier shopping destinations sprawling over 900,000 sq ft in the heart of Civil Lines, hosting 150+ international retail brands and INOX.

blue_world_theme_park.name: Blue World Theme & Water Park
blue_world_theme_park.description: Massive 25-acre international-standard amusement and aquatic theme park on Mandhana-Bithoor Road, featuring fairy-tale theme zones, extreme roller coasters, and wave pools.

kanpur_central_station.name: Kanpur Central Railway Station (Heritage Architecture)
kanpur_central_station.description: One of India's five busiest railway stations, opened in 1930 modeled after London's Charing Cross Station with grand red-brick arches and heritage facades.

ganga_barrage_lav_kush.name: Ganga Barrage (Lav Kush Barrage Promenade)
ganga_barrage_lav_kush.description: Colossal 621-meter bridge-dam across the holy Ganga connecting Kanpur to Unnao, celebrated as a vibrant evening hangout for cool breezes and riverside food stalls.

patthar_ghat_bithoor.name: Patthar Ghat (Bithoor)
patthar_ghat_bithoor.description: Monumental ghat built of solid red sandstone blocks by Raja Tikait Rai, minister of Awadh, housing an ancient Shiva temple with a unique blue kasauti-stone lingam.

iit_kanpur_campus.name: IIT Kanpur Green Campus
iit_kanpur_campus.description: Acclaimed 1,055-acre wooded campus founded in 1959 with American collaboration, renowned for brutalist modernist architecture, PK Kelkar Library, and gliding airstrip.
iit_kanpur_campus.best_time_to_visit: Daytime (Right at IIT Kanpur Metro Station)

kanpur_sangrahalaya.name: Kanpur Sangrahalaya (Kanpur City Museum)
kanpur_sangrahalaya.description: The official city museum housed in the historic colonial King Edward Memorial Hall at Phool Bagh, documenting Kanpur's rise as the 'Manchester of the East'.

siddhnath_temple_jajmau.name: Siddhnath Temple (Jajmau)
siddhnath_temple_jajmau.description: Ancient Shiva temple situated on high river bluffs in historic Jajmau, offering panoramic vistas of the holy Ganga and peaceful riverbank ghats.

dhruva_teela_bithoor.name: Dhruva Teela (Mound of Dhruva)
dhruva_teela_bithoor.description: Sacred mythological hillock in Bithoor revered as the spot where child devotee Dhruva performed rigorous penance standing on one leg to attain immortality as the Pole Star.

boodha_bargad.name: Boodha Bargad (Old Banyan Tree Monument)
boodha_bargad.description: Revered memorial spot marking the historic banyan tree in Nana Rao Park where 133 Indian freedom fighters were hanged by the British following the 1857 uprising.
boodha_bargad.best_time_to_visit: Daytime while exploring Nana Rao Park

naveen_market.name: Naveen Market Central Shopping Arcade
naveen_market.description: Symmetrical red-brick shopping quadrangle in the city center famed for Kanpur leather shoes, belts, bags, traditional cotton wear, and local street snacks.
naveen_market.best_time_to_visit: Afternoon to evening (Directly at Naveen Market Metro)

tapeshwari_devi_temple.name: Tapeshwari Devi Temple
tapeshwari_devi_temple.description: Historic shrine in Birhana Road where Mata Sita is believed to have performed severe austerities with goddesses Kamala, Vimala, and Saraswati.

baradevi_temple.name: Shri Baradevi Temple
baradevi_temple.description: A 1,700-year-old historic shrine in South Kanpur enshrining 12 petrified stone manifestations of the Mother Goddess, hosting South Kanpur's largest Navratri festival.

sudhanshu_ji_maharaj_ashram.name: Anand Dham Ashram (Sudhanshu Ji Maharaj)
sudhanshu_ji_maharaj_ashram.description: Spiritual hermitage on Bithoor Road famous for its grand artificial replica of Mount Kailash and Mansarovar Lake, caves, and sprawling landscaped gardens.

lal_imli_heritage_mill.name: Lal Imli Woollen Mill & Clock Tower
lal_imli_heritage_mill.description: Monumental 1876 red-brick woollen textile mill established by the British India Corporation, symbol of Kanpur's industrial zenith as the 'Manchester of the East'.
lal_imli_heritage_mill.best_time_to_visit: External architectural viewing in Civil Lines

bithoor_fort_ruins.name: Nana Saheb Peshwa Palace Ruins (Bithoor)
bithoor_fort_ruins.description: Ruins of the royal palace of Peshwa Nana Saheb that served as the war headquarters during the 1857 Uprising, housing a small museum and cannons.

bada_chauraha_market.name: Bada Chauraha Historic Trade Square
bada_chauraha_market.description: The central commercial crossroads of Kanpur, famous for historic bookshops, heritage cloth merchants, and Kanpur's legendary 'Thaggu Ke Laddu'.

rave_3_mall.name: Rave 3 Mall (Rawatpur)
rave_3_mall.description: Pioneering entertainment and shopping multiplex on Parbati Bagla Road near Rawatpur Metro, offering retail fashion brands and multi-cuisine dining.

sarsaiya_ghat.name: Sarsaiya Ghat & Evening Ganga Aarti
sarsaiya_ghat.description: Central and most accessible sacred ghat on the holy Ganga in Kanpur, popular for evening musical Ganga Aarti, holy dips, and dawn wooden boat rides.

kargil_park_moti_jheel.name: Kargil Vijay Park (Moti Jheel)
kargil_park_moti_jheel.description: Memorial park adjoining Moti Jheel honoring Operation Vijay martyrs, exhibiting retired Indian military equipment, fighter jet models, and illuminated fountains.

hbttu_heritage_campus.name: HBTU Heritage Technical Campus
hbttu_heritage_campus.description: Established in 1921 by Sir Spencer Harcourt Butler, this historic engineering campus in Nawabganj is globally pioneer in oil, paint, and leather chemical technologies.

christ_church_kanpur.name: Christ Church (Oldest Church in Kanpur 1840)
christ_church_kanpur.description: Consecrated in 1840 on The Mall Road, this is Kanpur's oldest surviving church building, designed with historic Gothic lancet windows and memorial brass plaques.

jajmau_ancient_mound.name: Jajmau Ancient Mound & Yayati Fort Site
jajmau_ancient_mound.description: Archaeological high mound dating to 1000 BCE identifying Kanpur's earliest civilization, excavated by ASI uncovering Northern Black Polished Ware and King Yayati's fort.

csjm_university_campus.name: CSJM University Campus (Kanpur University)
csjm_university_campus.description: Sprawling 264-acre green educational hub in Kalyanpur established in 1966, featuring grand academic quadrangles directly at Vishwavidyalaya Metro Station.

makhdum_shah_dargah_jajmau.name: Dargah Makhdum Shah Ala-ul-Haq (Jajmau)
makhdum_shah_dargah_jajmau.description: Venerated 14th-century Sufi shrine perched high on the Jajmau cliff over the Ganga, constructed in 1360 CE by Feroz Shah Tughlaq.

rave_moti_mall.name: Rave Moti Mall (Gurudev Chauraha)
rave_moti_mall.description: Popular lifestyle entertainment mall featuring multi-screen cinema, branded apparel outlets, and family dining near Moti Jheel and Gurudev Chauraha.

nawabganj_kanpur_ghat.name: Nawabganj Ganga Ghats
nawabganj_kanpur_ghat.description: Quiet series of river ghats in northern Kanpur near the zoo forest, popular for holy morning dips, scenic dawn boat cruises, and calm vistas.

ghanta_ghar_kanpur.name: Ghanta Ghar (Kanpur Central Clock Tower)
ghanta_ghar_kanpur.description: Historic colonial clock tower standing proudly near Kanpur Central railway station, long serving as an iconic civic landmark of the industrial metropolis.

parshwanath_digamber_jain_temple.name: Shri 1008 Parshwanath Digamber Jain Mandir (Generalganj)
parshwanath_digamber_jain_temple.description: Historic Jain temple in Generalganj enshrining an ancient idol of 23rd Tirthankara Lord Parshwanath, renowned for traditional marble carving.

leather_market_jajmau.name: Jajmau Leather Craft & Export Bazaar
leather_market_jajmau.description: Global hub for authentic Kanpur leather goods including equestrian saddlery, leather jackets, handcrafted footwear, and travel accessories directly from artisans.

subhash_park_cantonment.name: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Park (Cantonment)
subhash_park_cantonment.description: Immaculately maintained green park in Kanpur Cantonment featuring broad jogging tracks, floral beds, and a life-sized bronze statue of Netaji.

sports_village_green_park.name: Green Park Cricket Gallery & Hall of Fame
sports_village_green_park.description: Specialized cricket gallery within Green Park showcasing historic photographs, signed cricket bats, test match balls, and memorabilia from legendary matches.

spm_hospital_heritage_complex.name: Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee Memorial Enclave
spm_hospital_heritage_complex.description: Civic medical and memorial square on GT Road directly serving the Kalyanpur-Rawatpur corridor at SPM Hospital Metro Station.

gurudev_chauraha_cultural_hub.name: Gurudev Chauraha Cultural & Entertainment Junction
gurudev_chauraha_cultural_hub.description: Lively entertainment crossroads named after the historic Gurudev Cinema Palace, buzzing with student cafes, cinema halls, and street cuisine.

nayaganj_heritage_sarafa.name: Nayaganj Heritage Bullion & Dry Fruit Bazaar
nayaganj_heritage_sarafa.description: Kanpur's historic bullion and spices trade heartland directly served by the underground Naya Ganj Metro Station, famous for gold jewelry and wholesale nuts.
